versions.localizedDescription:
Track your spending with clarity and control — meet MoneyCircle.

MoneyCircle makes it easy to understand where your money goes.
With clean design, smart categorization, and intuitive insights,
you’ll gain control of your finances and uncover new opportunities to save.

If you've tried other expense tracking apps but found them cluttered or overwhelming,
MoneyCircle offers a refreshing alternative — simple, beautiful, and focused on what matters: your spending habits.

Key Features
Smart Categorization
MoneyCircle automatically organizes your expenses by category,
based on the total spent in each area.

Fast & Easy Entry
Just type in a spending item — MoneyCircle suggests a category
by learning from your past entries.
